info.title: Penguin Academy API
info.description: Implemented M5 API. Bearer-only Sanctum personal access tokens; browser session cookies are not accepted. Existing Blade/Fortify routes remain session-authenticated. All API responses use no-store. JSON resources use data; paginated collections add links and meta. Error responses use message/code and optional errors. Tokens grant abilities, never role, account-status, ownership or enrollment overrides. UTC timestamps. All authenticated requests: 120/minute per user; writes additionally share the existing 60/minute per-user academy limit with web writes. TLS is required outside local development. No real credentials or tokens appear in this document.

post.description: Credential-authenticated issuance in the JSON body only. Account must be active and have no mandatory password change. 5 requests/minute per normalized email+IP, and 30/minute per IP. Maximum 10 active tokens/account, enforced transactionally. Defaults to 60 minutes, maximum 1440. Students may request common read/enrollment/token abilities and progress:write; staff may request common abilities plus courses:write, lessons:write and reports:read. No wildcard. Never send credentials in the URL. Roles: Admin, Teacher, Student.

get.description: Own token metadata only, newest first. Includes expired tokens to permit revocation; hashes and plaintext are never listed. Roles: All active roles. Requires tokens:read. Current Policies also apply.

delete.description: Immediately revoke the current token or one owned token. Another user's token returns 404. Subsequent bearer requests return 401. Roles: All active roles. Requires tokens:revoke. Current Policies also apply.

Immediately revoke the current token or one owned token. Another user's token returns 404. Subsequent bearer requests return 401. Roles: All active roles. Requires tokens:revoke. Current Policies also apply.

get.description: Non-archived courses only. Students see published lesson counts; no private teacher fields. Searches title and summary. Unknown query fields rejected. Roles: Admin all; Teacher assigned; Student published. Requires courses:read. Current Policies also apply.
get.x-roles: Admin all; Teacher assigned; Student published

post.description: Creates a draft. Teachers are automatically assigned to themselves. Slugs are unique including archived courses and normalized to lowercase. Roles: Admin, Teacher. Requires courses:write. Current Policies also apply.

get.description: Returns course information and aggregate counts; not lesson content. Archived courses return 404. Roles: Admin; assigned Teacher; Student if published. Requires courses:read. Current Policies also apply.
get.x-roles: Admin; assigned Teacher; Student if published

patch.description: Partial update. Admin may reassign to an active teacher. Publication is a separate operation. Omitted fields retain their values; unknown or protected fields rejected. Roles: Admin; assigned Teacher. Requires courses:write. Current Policies also apply.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the course. Lessons, enrollments and completion history remain persisted. No hard deletion. Roles: Admin. Requires courses:write. Current Policies also apply.

put.description: Publish/unpublish idempotently. Publication requires an assigned active Teacher. Withdrawal and learning history are preserved when unpublished. Roles: Admin; assigned Teacher. Requires courses:write. Current Policies also apply.

get.description: Position-ordered, non-archived lessons. Students see published lessons only. Collection entries omit content; use showLesson for reading. Roles: Admin; assigned Teacher; Student with active enrollment in a published course. Requires lessons:read. Current Policies also apply.
get.x-roles: Admin; assigned Teacher; Student with active enrollment in a published course

post.description: Creates a draft. Position is allocated under the existing course transaction lock and cannot be submitted by the client. Roles: Admin; assigned Teacher. Requires lessons:write. Current Policies also apply.

get.description: Includes plain-text content. Student requires an active enrollment, published course and published non-archived lesson. Cross-course ID returns 404. Roles: Admin; assigned Teacher; enrolled Student. Requires lessons:read. Current Policies also apply.

patch.description: Partial title/content update through the shared LessonActions. Publication and ordering are separate operations. Roles: Admin; assigned Teacher. Requires lessons:write. Current Policies also apply.

delete.description: Soft-deletes lesson; preserves all historical completion records and increments course order version. Roles: Admin; assigned Teacher. Requires lessons:write. Current Policies also apply.

put.description: Sets publication state. Current progress automatically excludes unpublished lessons; historical completions remain persisted. Roles: Admin; assigned Teacher. Requires lessons:write. Current Policies also apply.

Submit every current non-archived lesson exactly once, with the latest course lesson_order_version. Course lock and collision-safe position update are reused. A stale version returns 409; invalid set returns 422. Roles: Admin; assigned Teacher. Requires lessons:write. Current Policies also apply.

get.description: Non-archived courses only. Active enrollments by default. Includes safe student identity and SQL-calculated progress. Student lists retain withdrawal/unpublication history without granting lesson access. Out-of-scope course/student filters return an empty list. Roles: Admin all; Teacher assigned courses; Student own. Requires enrollments:read. Current Policies also apply.
get.x-roles: Admin all; Teacher assigned courses; Student own

parameters.name: student_id
parameters.description: Staff only; restricts within authorized scope.

post.description: Published course and active Student required. Students must omit student_id. Staff must supply it. A new row returns 201; repeated enrollment or re-enrollment returns 200 with the same row and original joined date. Completion history is retained. Roles: Student own; Admin; assigned Teacher. Requires enrollments:write. Current Policies also apply.

200.description: Existing enrollment retained or reactivated. No duplicate record.

delete.description: Invokes existing withdrawal behavior, never hard-deletes. Repeated withdrawal returns 204 and preserves the first withdrawn_at. Allowed after unpublication, denied for archived courses. Completion history preserved. Roles: Student own; Admin; assigned Teacher. Requires enrollments:write. Current Policies also apply.

get.description: Uses current published non-deleted lessons. Zero eligible lessons gives zero percent. Readable after withdrawal/unpublication, but archived courses are denied. This endpoint does not grant lesson access. next_lesson_id is null after withdrawal/unpublication. Roles: Student own; Admin; assigned Teacher. Requires progress:read. Current Policies also apply.

put.description: Empty body. Requires own active enrollment and accessible published lesson in this enrollment's course. Idempotent; repeated requests do not duplicate records or alter another student's history. Returns current persisted progress. No staff proxy completion. Roles: Student own only. Requires progress:write. Current Policies also apply.

delete.description: Empty body. Requires own active enrollment and accessible published lesson in this enrollment's course. Idempotent; repeated requests do not duplicate records or alter another student's history. Returns current persisted progress. No staff proxy completion. Roles: Student own only. Requires progress:write. Current Policies also apply.

get.description: SQL aggregate summary and paginated course metrics. Withdrawn enrollments and archived courses excluded. Draft courses and active enrollments of inactive users remain in operational totals; active_students separately counts distinct active Student accounts. Admin-only account counts cover all active accounts. Average progress is the unweighted mean of current active enrollment percentages, including zero-lesson rows. Roles: Admin all; Teacher assigned courses. Requires reports:read. Current Policies also apply.

bearerAuth.description: Authorization: Bearer <token>. Mandatory expires_at, maximum 24 hours. No cookie fallback.

access_token.description: Returned exactly once. Store securely. Never place in URLs, logs or screenshots.

examples.message: You are not authorized to perform this operation.

teacher_id.description: Admin only; active Teacher account, or null. Teacher creators are assigned to themselves. Cannot remove the teacher from a published course.
Admin only; active Teacher account, or null. Teacher creators are assigned to themselves. Cannot remove the teacher from a published course.

password.description: Existing password; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes, not characters.

student_id.description: Required for staff; forbidden for students. Must identify an active Student account.

Error401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked token; disabled account; invalid issuance credentials.

Error403.description: Insufficient ability or policy permission; password change required.

Error422.description: Invalid payload or business-rule violation. Field errors included.

Error429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry-After header indicates delay.

Error500.description: Unexpected server error; private details are not serialized.

Error404.description: Resource absent, archived, nested under a different course, or token not owned.

Error409.description: Stale lesson order version. Refresh and retry.
